title: Sum of N Natural Numbers
description: Read a positive integer `N` and calculate the sum of all integers from `1` to `N` using a loop.
instructions: Add every integer from `1` to `N` into `total` and print `total`.
hints: In Java, use `long` if `N` can be up to 100,000 (sum ~ 5 * 10^9).
Loop `i` from 1 to N and accumulate `total += i`.

n = int(input().strip())
